content.title: GFF Q2 Deep Dive: Tariffs and Consumer Weakness Pressure Revenue, Margins Hold Up
content.summary: Multi-industry consumer and professional products manufacturer Griffon Corporation (NYSE:GFF) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, with sales falling 5.3% year on year to $613.6 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.5 billion at the midpoint came in 2.3% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.50 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
